result.brief: 提出行扫描并行解码，仅重定义视觉 token 前驱关系，将统一自回归模型的视觉解码深度从 HW 降至 H+W，无需改骨干或加参数，并保持多模态与视频生成质量。
result.reason: Redefines visual token decoding order in unified AR models, cutting visual decoding depth from HW to H+W without changing backbone; directly serves unified understanding-generation efficiency.
